Notation in Programming: Exploring BQN, Symbolic Manipulation, and Expressive Syntax - Cheery Chen - ACCU 2025 Short Talks
---

How can good notation unlock new ideas in programming? In this ACCU 2025 lightning talk, Cheery Chen explores the power of notation in programming, mathematics, and computational thinking. Focusing on symbolic notation and its role in expressing ideas clearly and beautifully, this talk introduces the BQN language and compares it with familiar C++ syntax to highlight the expressive potential of alternative programming languages.

Chen starts by showing the historical roots of algebraic notation, Arabic numerals, and the very word “algorithm,” then dives into how symbolic manipulation in programming—like calculating the arithmetic mean and quadratic mean—reveals underlying mathematical structures.
